method: Viewed original source artwork, producer masks/contact sheets, independent native-resolution motion crops, enlarged steam crops and last/first frame pairs. Fully decoded all 84 frames of each video and independently recomputed adjacent-frame and seam metrics. Checked SHA-256 before/after decode and again at report writing.
limitations: No full-speed playback or audio audition performed.
Approval applies only to these exact visual hashes, not integrated product quality or production readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Source artwork, producer mask/contact, eight independently extracted candle-region samples, four enlarged mug-region samples, and last/first frame pairs inspected. Window mullions, mountain skyline, stars, telescope, stairs, table, books and mug remain stable in these samples.

Table candle/lamp flames vary gently and locally. The mug wisp is very faint and stays immediately above the cup; stair edges behind it remain recognizable without an obvious rectangular mask boundary. This is intentionally minimal motion, not an animated night sky.

Independent full decode reproduces a seam ratio of 1.6715× against the unchanged threshold of 4; absolute seam change is 0.00735 on a 0–255 channel scale. No abrupt exposure or framing jump apparent in sampled seam frames.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Source artwork, producer mask/contact, eight independently extracted hearth samples, four enlarged mug-region samples, and last/first frame pairs inspected. Round windows, hanging leaves, furniture, rug pattern, fire tools, logs and foreground mug preserve their geometry.

The right hearth has clearly visible, plausible flame variation contained inside the fireplace. Stone edges, fire-tool silhouettes and foreground leaves show no evident motion spill in sampled crops. Mug steam is low-contrast and restrained, with the carpet pattern behind it stable.

Independent full decode reproduces a seam ratio of 1.4877× against the unchanged threshold of 4; absolute seam change is 0.13064 on a 0–255 channel scale. The flame silhouette differs modestly at the seam, comparable to ordinary flicker rather than a frame-wide reset.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.
